{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "You requested a summer outfit for an autumn season in the input data, which presents a contradiction; however, following your explicit field quote stating you are performing this charity gala in summer, I have designed an ensemble suitable for warm weather that honors your recovery journey. Since you are recovering from illness, the cut prioritizes comfort and ease of movement while maintaining the elegance required for an upscale restaurant setting. The outfit avoids a monochromatic column look as requested, instead utilizing subtle tonal variations to create visual interest without overwhelming the senses. This selection respects your refusal against opaque tights, ensuring legs remain unclad or in sheer hosiery to keep the silhouette light and breathable for the evening.

A flowing midi dress in a soft chiffon with a draped neckline in Hex #E8D5C4 (dusty rose), featuring a relaxed A-line cut that falls to mid-calf length.
Slight elasticized waistband, straight hemline, dusty rose, lightweight woven cotton-blend with a subtle sheen.
Strappy sandals with a low block heel in Hex #9B7E6D (warm taupe), open toe design with a slender ankle strap.
Gold vermeil drop earrings and a small structured clutch in matching taupe leather to complete the look.

This outfit works because the loose, breathable fabrics accommodate your body's needs during recovery while the dusty rose hue offers a gentle, flattering tone that boosts confidence without feeling demanding. The low heel provides necessary stability for an evening out after illness, ensuring you can stand and mingle comfortably throughout the charity event. By avoiding a single-color column look and incorporating texture in the dress and accessories, the ensemble creates a balanced, elegant presence appropriate for the upscale restaurant setting. Finally, the open-toed shoes and absence of opaque tights keep the silhouette light and airy, perfectly matching your wish to feel relaxed yet sophisticated during the summer celebration."}
